paper.citation: Ngcezu SA, Rabus H (2021) Investigation into the foundations of the track-event theory of cell survival and the radiation action model based on nanodosimetry. Radiat Environ Biophys 60:559-578. https://doi.org/10.1007/s00411-021-00936-4

claims.text: Eq. 9 reduces to the LQ model in the low-dose limit (α=p, β=q^2/2).
claims.test: Compare survival_tet vs survival_tet_lq_lowdose for p=0.1, q=0.05.
claims.verdict: PASS — relative error < 5e-3 for D ≤ 2 Gy and grows at high D as expected.

claims.text: At high dose, S → (1+qD) e^{-(p+q)D} is dominated by exp(-(p+q)D); the (1+qD) prefactor is a polynomial bump and ln S is essentially linear in D.
claims.verdict: PASS — ratio matches (1+qD) exactly by construction; at D=50 Gy survival is ~10^-3 and dominated by the exponential.

claims.text: Eq. 13 (large-N approx.) ≈ pure exponential exp(-pD) for practically relevant doses; the quadratic correction reaches unity only at very high doses (paper says ~500 Gy for N=5e8, q=40 Gy^-1).
claims.verdict: PASS — D*≈790 Gy, same order of magnitude as paper's 'on the order of 500 Gy'. At 80 Gy the quadratic correction is 1.02e-02, completely negligible. Eq.11 and Eq.13 agree to relative error 8.53e-05 over D∈[1,1000] Gy.

claims.text: Same as C3 phrased differently: at practically relevant doses (≤80 Gy) the RAMN survival curve is essentially exponential.
claims.verdict: PASS — quadratic term is 1.02e-02 ≪ 1 at D=80 Gy.

claims.text: Eq. 15 of present paper differs from Besserer & Schneider 2015b Eq. 7 by an extra mixed term R·p·q·D^2 and a cubic R^2·q^3·D^3/6 term.
claims.verdict: PASS — symbolic expansion confirms the extra terms exactly.
PASS — both limits match to machine precision (err=0.00e+00, 0.00e+00).

claims.text: Schneider et al.'s naive PCL ≈ binomial gives values orders of magnitude larger than the corrected PCL of Eq. 28; this is the paper's key nanodosimetry-side correction.
claims.verdict: PASS — for F2=0.01, n=6, nt=1e-5: PCL_naive/PCL_corrected ≈ 4.87e+04, i.e. ~5 orders of magnitude. This is exactly the paper's complaint.

claims.text: Eq. 31 sanity: only-k=2 → P(DSB|IC)=1/2; flat F_k → P(DSB|IC)→1.
